name: BluetoothService
description: Discovers and manages Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) smart home devices including lightbulbs, outlets, and water controllers. Provides device scanning, RSSI-based distance calculation, and device control capabilities. Automatically filters out watches and wearables.

actions.name: scan
actions.description: Start or stop BLE scanning for nearby devices. Parameters: action (start/stop).

actions.name: listDevices
actions.description: List all discovered Bluetooth devices with their type, RSSI, distance, and controllability status.

actions.name: getDevice
actions.description: Get detailed information about a specific device. Parameters: address (MAC address).

actions.name: controlDevice
actions.description: Control a Bluetooth device (turn on/off, set brightness, etc.). Parameters: address, action, value (optional).

actions.name: getScanInterval
actions.description: Get the current scan interval in seconds.

actions.name: setScanInterval
actions.description: Set the scan interval in seconds. Parameters: interval (30-300 seconds).

actions.name: getStatus
actions.description: Get service status including scanning state, device count, and configuration.

features: Device type detection (lightbulbs, outlets, water controllers)
